title: GlobalProtect Connect Before Logon (PLAP) for Hybrid Azure AD Join Autopilot via Microsoft Intune — Deployment, Registration & Reboot-Sequencing Troubleshooting
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 — the most complex of the pre-logon VPN line: GlobalProtect PLAP deployment + Hybrid Azure AD Join Autopilot ESP sequencing + deep failure-mode diagnostics (unzip/0x87D30067, reboot orchestration, execution context, GP service readiness, Win10-vs-Win11) + IME/agent log capture.

Distinct from the Cisco SBL/PLAP product — this is Palo Alto GlobalProtect Connect Before Logon in the Autopilot hybrid-join, user-initiated-VPN scenario (customer moved off Always On VPN after a security incident).
Palo Alto GlobalProtect portal/gateway + app internals deferred to Palo Alto docs.
